unit: Geometry · Chapter II. Vectors in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Vectors are coplanar if, laid off from one point, they lie in one plane; any two vectors are coplanar.
stages.headlineEnglish: Vectors are coplanar if, laid off from one point, they lie in one plane; any two vectors are coplanar.

stages.headline: In a cube AB, AD and AC are coplanar (in plane ABCD), but AB, AD, AA₁ are not.
stages.headlineEnglish: In a cube AB, AD and AC are coplanar (in plane ABCD), but AB, AD, AA₁ are not.

stages.headline: If c = xa + yb then a, b, c are coplanar; conversely, if a and b are not collinear, every coplanar c has this form.
stages.headlineEnglish: If c = xa + yb then a, b, c are coplanar; conversely, if a and b are not collinear, every coplanar c has this form.

stages.headline: Which triple of cube vectors is coplanar?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which triple of cube vectors is coplanar?

stages.headline: c = 2a − 3b. Are a, b, c coplanar?
stages.headlineEnglish: c = 2a − 3b. Are a, b, c coplanar?
stages.problemText: c = 2a − 3b. Are a, b, c coplanar?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. c is a combination of a and b.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. c is a combination of a and b.
